column2: This is HETMANATE I will write a description.
Attempt to become the Kozachina Hetman.
Might makes right! Prove your claim to the Hetmanate through force and take your rightful spot as the head of the Kozachina Host.
Clearing this land will result in buildings being destroyed! Those currently living in those lands will not be happy.
The sovereign has recently deconstructed this Holding for farmland. The peasants are arming themselves, hell-bent on reversing this decision.
